tagline: Custom t-shirts, Cricut designs and personalised gifts, made by hand.
hero_text: Personalised t-shirts, hoodies, tote bags and gifts for birthdays, hen dos, teams and special days. See our latest work and message us on Instagram to order.
about_text: Every piece is designed, cut and pressed by hand at our little studio. We love turning your ideas into something you can wear or gift. Tell us what you have in mind and we'll make it happen.
custom_text: Got an idea, a photo or a name you want on something? We do one-offs and group orders.

custom_steps.title: Send us a message
custom_steps.text: DM us on Instagram with your idea, the item, sizes and when you need it.

custom_steps.title: We design it
custom_steps.text: We'll send you a mock-up and a price before anything is made.

custom_steps.title: Collect or post
custom_steps.text: Once you're happy, we make it and arrange collection or delivery.
